g.title: crate Core UI contracts, application setup and runtime implementation.
crate::app Public application builder and native window entry.
crate::client Host event dispatch, tracing, and per-application boundary state.
crate::client::dispatch::a11y Assistive-technology requests and overlay dismissals, both run
crate::client::dispatch::common What the host event modules share: the stale and modal drops,
crate::client::dispatch::diagnostics Diagnostic reports of the engine: layout warnings, dropped draw
crate::client::dispatch::env Window and environment events: the environment, the frame clock,
crate::client::dispatch::gpu GPU texture sharing events (feature `gpu-interop`, experimental).
crate::client::dispatch::ime Input method events for a node's IME session.
crate::client::dispatch::key Key events: the handler route up the tree (stopped by an open
crate::client::dispatch::platform Answers and failures from the platform: effect results, asset
crate::client::dispatch::pointer Pointer, wheel, hover, file-drop and activation events.
crate::client::notice The core's own diagnostics of the client: `tracing` messages that
crate::client::state Per-App client state for the host boundary.
crate::client::trace Debug-only ordered comparison traces for test clients.
crate::custom Primitive contracts support custom components and measurement.
crate::custom::inline_view Place retained views in a shaped paragraph.
crate::custom::measured_leaf The `Primitive` builder: a leaf node whose author measures its size.
crate::custom::measurement The measurement contract of a primitive: constraints, sizes and baselines.
crate::custom::misuse Report component misuse at its declaration site.
crate::custom::node Opaque mounted node identity and component focus queries.
crate::custom::text_editing Attach native editing and query its geometry through public parts.
crate::custom::text_shaping Shape a paragraph with the App's text engine outside drawing and measurement.
crate::diagnostics Diagnostics: error tracking and turn records.
crate::diagnostics::errors The errors of the running App that reached its default sink.
crate::diagnostics::stats Counters for granularity checks that a test screen reports.
crate::diagnostics::why Dependency chain explanation for debugging.
crate::draw Drawing tools paint canvases and local element layers.
crate::draw::offscreen Fixed-resolution images drawn with the same `Draw` vocabulary as canvases.
crate::embed Public embedded App configuration and lifetime.
crate::geometry Shared logical geometry for views and drawing.
crate::gpu_interop GPU texture sharing with an external render engine (experimental).
crate::gpu_interop::import Images an external render engine shares, imported into the window's GPU device.
crate::gpu_interop::import::image Import an external image: its handle, status, frames and frame publisher.
crate::gpu_interop::import::inbox State an engine's threads share with a UI task, and the wakes between them.
crate::gpu_interop::import::registry The App's record of its imports and the adapter signal.
crate::gpu_interop::share An image an engine shares with the UI, imported again on each new device.
crate::gpu_interop::share::app_side The App's side of a shared image: status, size, renewal and import.
crate::gpu_interop::share::link The engine's side of a shared image: its requests, textures and frames.
crate::i18n Public use_locale and message names of the facade.
crate::launch Shared application launch and read-only inspection boundary.
crate::launch::inspect Read-only inspection of a started application.
crate::launch::runtime Concrete host callbacks and the ordered App turn loop.
crate::launch::settings Application configuration and startup validation.
crate::motion Public animation names of the facade: frame loops, values and transitions.
crate::platform Platform services and window loop entry.
crate::platform::lifecycle Owner-scoped application lifecycle subscriptions and ordered dispatch.
crate::platform::window_loop Start the engine's native window loop; report its errors as diagnostics.
crate::state Reactive handles, setup, contexts and state machines.
crate::state::__private Public macro expansion details hidden from documentation.
crate::style Public style names of the facade: styles, lengths, colors and themes.
crate::style::theme Public theme token tables of the facade.
crate::task Public async names of the facade: tasks, resources and actions.
crate::view Views describe elements, control flow, input and semantics.
crate::view::boundary Owner boundaries for context, theme, locale and messages.
crate::view::children The child lists the group components accept: a tuple of views or a `Vec`.
crate::view::descriptor Re-export unmounted descriptions and reusable factory contracts.
crate::view::descriptor::factory Reusable factories create a fresh view for each opening.
crate::view::descriptor::sealed_view_fn Limit reusable view factories to closures.
crate::view::edit_phase The phases reported by a continuous value edit.
crate::view::editing_data Passive native editing settings and edit notifications.
crate::view::element_data The element type and the modifier contract of every element builder.
crate::view::elements Primitive elements and layout containers.
crate::view::elements::builders Nodes expose shared element builders and their modifier contract.
crate::view::elements::container Layout containers: column, row, grid, stack, scroll and spacer (box nodes).
crate::view::elements::text The text elements: [`text`] and [`rich_text`], text [`Node`]s.
crate::view::elements::text_binding This module binds rich text and styled spans in one render effect.
crate::view::exit_layout Select how a retained exit participates in its parent's layout.
crate::view::flow::branch Control flow: show, show_some and dynamic.
crate::view::flow::error_boundary Error boundary for catching child errors.
crate::view::flow::list Keyed and indexed lists retain item identity across view updates.
crate::view::flow::virtual_list Virtualized list with viewport-based row mounting.
crate::view::handler_layers One ordered handler list per event kind, delivered layer by layer.
crate::view::hover Hover state and pointer tracking.
crate::view::ime_session The IME session of a focusable node that edits its own text, and its events.
crate::view::input Public input values and handler events: keyboard, pointer, wheel and a11y.
crate::view::modifier_keys Read the modifier keys held, from a handler that gets no event.
crate::view::modifiers These helpers hold the logic the modifier methods share.
crate::view::mount Mounting turns descriptions into retained host nodes.
crate::view::mount::attachments Mounting binds the references, part hooks and canvas regions attached to a node.
crate::view::mount::create Mounting writes a host node's first properties and listener flags.
crate::view::mount::diagnostics Mounting reports a node that can be pressed but cannot be reached.
crate::view::mount::draw Mounting binds the draw layers of a host node.
crate::view::mount::editing Mounting wires a node's text editing callbacks and binds its editing data.
crate::view::mount::facts What mounting decides about a host node before it binds its effects.
crate::view::mount::part_input Part input preserves original targets and caller customization order.
crate::view::mount::part_pointer Pointer routing retains adopted part identity while native capture runs.
crate::view::mount::parts Mounted parts combine caller constraints and preserve behavior defaults.
crate::view::mount::region_collection Region collections share keyed diff and item owner lifecycles.
crate::view::mount::region_template Region templates retain one part while adoption lifetimes change.
crate::view::mount::regions Region registries retain keyed attachments across geometry updates.
crate::view::mount::resolve Mounting resolves a host node's declared modifiers into the input of each stage.
crate::view::mount::semantics Ordered semantic patches publish one canonical value per node.
crate::view::mount::style Mounting binds the style, disabled and selected states of a host node.
crate::view::node_draw Attach custom painting that reads native editing geometry.
crate::view::node_modifiers Inherent node modifiers and ordered deferred part transformations.
crate::view::node_ref Node references expose exact targets and shared host observations.
crate::view::overlays Overlay stacking and popup management.
crate::view::owner The component author's owner: scoped resources without graph access.
crate::view::part Parts attach behavior and expose the state of their actual target.
crate::view::part_data These values carry mounted part constraints, references and hooks.
crate::view::ref_data Passive reference binding lifecycle and layout subscriptions.
crate::view::requests Event requests and async I/O.
crate::view::root Root component mounting and lifecycle.
crate::view::semantics_data Passive semantic modifier patches and preserved public input reads.
crate::view::span Styled spans for rich text paragraphs.
crate::view::state View state and reactive composition.
crate::view::sync_hook The one way to run a user's function inside an engine borrow.
crate::view::text_edits Guard the undelivered native edits without borrowing the view tree.
crate::view::tree Retain what only core knows about a node and write directly to the engine.
